title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 070 ]

blocks.text: According to experimental psychology, your physical appearance makes up 55% of a first impression. The physical appearance includes facial expressions, eye contact, and general appearance. The way you sound makes up 35% of the first impression This includes how fast or slowly, loudly or softly you speak, and your tone of voice. The actual words you use count for only 10% . Therefore, it is safe to conclude that people form their first impressions based mostly on how you look , then on how you speak and least of all on what you say.

readingSentences.english: According to experimental psychology, your physical appearance makes up 55% of a first impression.
readingSentences.korean: 실험 심리학에 따르면, 신체적인 외모가 첫인상의 55%를 차지한다.

readingSentences.english: The physical appearance includes facial expressions, eye contact, and general appearance.
readingSentences.korean: 신체적인 외모에는 얼굴 표정, 눈맞춤, 그리고 전반적인 겉모습이 포함된다.

readingSentences.english: The way you sound makes up 35% of the first impression.
This includes how fast or slowly, loudly or softly you speak, and your tone of voice.
readingSentences.korean: 여기에는 얼마나 빠르거나 느리게, 크게 혹은 부드럽게 말하는지와 목소리의 음조가 포함된다.

readingSentences.english: The actual words you use count for only 10% .
readingSentences.korean: 당신이 사용하는 실제 어휘와 말의 내용은 단지 10%만을 차지할 뿐이다.

readingSentences.english: Therefore, it is safe to conclude that people form their first impressions based mostly on how you look , then on how you speak and least of all on what you say.
readingSentences.korean: 그러므로 사람들은 주로 당신의 겉모습에 근거하여, 다음으로는 말하는 방식에, 그리고 무엇을 말하는가에는 가장 적게 근거하여 첫인상을 형성한다고 결론지어도 무방하다.
